tasks.gr11-pat-completion-t4: Topic: PAT Completion and Documentation. Cover the three phases of the CAPS IT PAT (analysis/design, development, testing/documentation), what a system requirements document contains, how to write a user manual (audience-appropriate, step-by-step instructions, screenshots), writing a technical specification (data structures, algorithms, module descriptions), testing evidence (test plans, screenshots of results), and submitting a complete, professional PAT. Ask Grade 11 learners to identify which PAT phase a given artefact belongs to, evaluate a user manual extract, select appropriate testing evidence, and explain what the analysis phase must deliver.
tasks.gr11-debugging-testing-t4: Topic: Debugging and Testing. Cover the three categories of programming errors (syntax errors — caught by compiler/interpreter; runtime errors — crashes during execution; logic errors — wrong output, hardest to find), debugging strategies (desk-checking/tracing, using a debugger, adding temporary output statements, rubber-duck debugging), writing a formal test plan (test case ID, input data, expected output, actual output, pass/fail), constructing a trace table to follow variable values through iterations, and boundary/edge-case testing. Ask Grade 11 learners to classify a given error, complete a trace table for a loop, identify the bug in a code snippet, and write a test case for a specified function.
tasks.gr11-exam-consolidation-t4: Topic: Examination Consolidation — Full-Year Revision. Revisit the highest-yield topics across the year: OOP (class diagrams, object creation, constructors, getter/setter methods), file handling (read/write/append modes, looping through file contents), SQL queries (SELECT with WHERE/ORDER BY, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, aggregate functions), network topologies and protocols, and social implications (POPIA, cybercrime types, security measures). Ask Grade 11 learners to answer mixed-paper-style questions that integrate multiple topics — for example, a program that validates input, stores to file, and queries a database — as well as identify and correct errors in provided code or SQL.
